title: Smart-Kenish 4.0: Autonomous Green Mine (Team-018)
description: Smart-Kenish 4.0: Polymetallic digital mine on OpenEgiz with trolley-assist decarbonization, AI grade blending, TKPH predictive tire thermal monitoring, and 2-generation What-If contingency response.

panels.title: 🎮 3D Digital Twin Cockpit :: Aktau-Mys Open-Pit Mine (Rule 9.1 Compliance)

options.content:
LIVE 3D SPATIAL DIGITAL TWIN (24 TWINS · THREE.JS ENGINE)

ГОК «Ақтау-Мыс» 3D WebGL Digital Twin Cockpit

Интерактивный 3D-двойник рудника: троллейвозный подъем 1200В (8.5%), сквозной цикл Drill-to-Mill, радар IBIS-FM устойчивости борта (FoS), EKF-PID шихтовка 0.850% Cu и онлайн-сценарии What-If.

panels.title: Smart-Kenish Mine Flow Topology & Energy Decarbonization Architecture

options.content:
### ⛰️ Aktau Polymetallic Open-Pit Digital Mine (12 Mt/a) :: Unified Process Flow

| Process Zone | Elevation & Asset | Target Parameter | Status & Telemetry |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **North Bench** | Horizon **+60m** \| Shovel **EX-01** (ЭКГ-15 30t) | **1.35% Cu** (High-Grade Chalcopyrite) | P&L feed blending control |
| **South Bench** | Horizon **-60m** \| Shovel **EX-02** (CAT 6020B 22t) | **0.45% Cu** (Low-Grade Ore) | Sump Dewatering (**WP-01/02**) |
| **Haul Ramp** | Continuous **8.5% Incline** (1.8 km Catenary) | **1200V DC** Overhead Trolley-Assist | Speed **24.5 km/h** (vs 12.2 km/h Diesel) |
| **Primary Crusher** | **ККД-1500/180** (2400 t/h) + Standby **Metso LT140** | Concentrator Target **0.850% Cu ±0.03%** | Tramp Metal Protection & Auto Relief |
| **Microgrid Substation** | **6 MW** Traction Substation + **2 MWh BESS** | **Peak Shaving & Regen Energy Capture** | Industrial Tariff **$0.062/kWh** |

> 🛰️ **Live Spatial GIS Topology & TUI:** Консольный монитор: `make monitor` | Геометрия: `team/data/mine_spatial_topology.geojson` (7 геодезических слоев, датум WGS84)
